title: Best AI Tools for Spreadsheets (Excel & Google Sheets)
dek: Some AI tools write formulas from a description; others live inside the sheet and edit it for you. This guide sorts the best AI tools for spreadsheets by how they actually work — so you pick the right kind for your data and your app.

seo.metaDescription: The best AI tools for spreadsheets, sorted by how they work: built-in assistants, external chatbots, and AI-native sheets — with who each is best for.

sources.label: Google Workspace — Gemini in Google Sheets

richText: "AI for spreadsheets" covers three very different things: an assistant built into your spreadsheet, an outside chatbot you copy formulas from, and a new kind of AI-native spreadsheet. They suit different needs, so the useful way to choose is by how the tool works — not by which has the longest feature list.

body.text: Built into your spreadsheet: Copilot and Gemini

body.richText: These are the most convenient because they work where your data already lives. Microsoft's Copilot in Excel can suggest formulas, create charts, and summarise a table in plain English; Google's Gemini side panel does the same inside Google Sheets, including generating tables and formulas. Both read the sheet directly, so you skip the copy-paste.

body.text: An outside chatbot: ChatGPT or Claude

richText: A general chatbot does not touch your file, but it is excellent at turning a described task into a formula and explaining what an existing formula does. It works for both Excel and Google Sheets, and it is free to start. The trade-off is the copy-paste loop and the need to verify — see

Some tools are built around AI from the ground up. Rows is a spreadsheet with an AI assistant and live data connections; upload-and-ask tools like Julius let you drop in a file and get charts and answers in plain English. body.richText: Whichever type you pick, treat AI output as a draft. Test any formula on rows where you know the answer, and sanity-check any chart against the raw numbers before you share it.

items.question: Does Excel have built-in AI?
items.answerRichText: Yes — Copilot in Excel can write formulas, build charts, and summarise data inside the app. It is a paid feature tied to a Microsoft 365 plan with Copilot, so whether you have it depends on your subscription.

items.question: Does Google Sheets have built-in AI?
items.answerRichText: Yes. Gemini appears as a side panel in Google Sheets and can generate formulas, tables, and summaries. Like Copilot, it is part of paid Workspace plans, so availability depends on your subscription and region.

items.question: What is the best free AI tool for spreadsheets?
items.answerRichText: A general chatbot like ChatGPT or Claude, used to write and explain formulas. It works with both Excel and Google Sheets on a free tier, as long as you paste the description in and verify the result yourself.

items.question: Can AI clean and analyse my spreadsheet automatically?
items.answerRichText: Upload-and-ask tools can suggest cleaning steps and produce charts and summaries from a file you provide. Always review the steps it takes and confirm the output against your raw data before relying on it.
